programmes.d: Indulging in some high-tech sightseeing at the site of a major historical event, Crichton and his friends are sucked through a time rift and find themselves in the middle of a key battle.

programmes.t: Farscape: Farscape: S2 E13 - Look At The Princess, Part 3: The Maltese Crichton
programmes.d: John Crichton faces eighty years as a statue. That is, until the Scarran Cargn decapitates the statue and drops the head into a vat of acid.
A brain-sucking alien and a pack of crazed Xarai threaten D'Argo, Chiana and Jool.

programmes.t: Farscape: Farscape: S2 E14 - Beware Of Dog
programmes.d: The crew bring aboard an alien tracker to remove some creatures that came aboard hidden in some cargo.
Traveling to a warring planet to obtain medicine for Talyn, who was injured in a skirmish with a Peacekeeper Retrieval Squad.

programmes.t: Farscape: Farscape: S2 E15 - Won't Get Fooled Again
programmes.d: Crichton has returned to Earth. Or has he always been on Earth all this time? People from his past and present appear.

Talyn gets swallowed by a Budong, and it is up to Stark to save them; Crichton, already distrustful of Crais, believes he and Aeryn are having an affair while Talyn himself soon shows his hatred of the human.

programmes.t: Farscape: Farscape: S2 E16 - The Locket
programmes.d: A temporal distortion traps Aeryn and John on a planet's surface, where they live out the rest of their lives.
Parasitic Energy Riders hitch a ride on Moya, planning to plant themselves inside the bodies of the crew.

programmes.t: Farscape: Farscape: S2 E17 - The Ugly Truth
programmes.d: Crais and Talyn return. The crew are put on trial for an attack that Talyn made on an alien ship.
The Peacekeeper Retrieval Squad finally reveals its true mission when it confronts Crichton and his crew.

programmes.t: Farscape: Farscape: S2 E18 - A Clockwork Nebari
programmes.d: A Nebari group comes aboard Moya and attempts to mind cleanse everyone using a drug. Pilot and Rygel are the only two who can resist the effects.
Scorpius (Wayne Pygram) risks it all when appealing to Crichton (Ben Browder) for an alliance by revealing his shrouded past.

programmes.t: Farscape: Farscape: S2 E19 - Liars, Guns And Money, Part 1: A Not So Simple Plan
programmes.d: D'Argo finally gets a lead on his son, Jothee. He will do anything to get him back, but Jothee will be sold as a slave.
Crichton's ship suddenly begins flying toward the sun and he, along with crewmates Aeryn and Crais, battles to override its compulsion.

programmes.t: Farscape: Farscape: S2 E20 - Liars, Guns And Money, Part 2: With Friends Like These
programmes.d: With the loot from the Depository heist at hand, D'Argo anxiously waits to make contact with the Slave Traders.
Crichton and his crew take a cruise on a "pleasure planet," but it turns out to be more of a pain than they bargained for.

programmes.t: Farscape: Farscape: S2 E21 - Liars, Guns And Money, Part 3: Plan B
programmes.d: The crew is going to break into the depository to free Crichton. Crichton is being tortured for wormhole technology.
A dangerous species unlocks the long-held secrets to wormhole technology, unleashing the fury of the Ancients.

programmes.t: Farscape: Farscape: S2 E22 - Die Me, Dichotomy
programmes.d: Wealthy from their bank heist, Moya's crew heads straight to meet with Diagnosan Tocot, a famous surgeon whom they hope can heal Moya's burns.
Crichton and Aeryn race to construct the ultimate weapon in order to survive an attack by the Scarrans.

programmes.t: Farscape: Farscape: S3 E1 - Season Of Death
programmes.d: D'Argo and Stark try to heal John, left with his head open on an operating table, while Scorpius attempts to avoid discovery.
A strange ship bent on self-destruction targets Moya and with Crichton in a coma, D'Argo has to save the day.

programmes.t: Farscape: Farscape: S3 E2 - Suns And Lovers
programmes.d: Moya docks at a commerce station so the crew can spend some of their money. Disaster strikes when the station is hit by a storm.
Aeryn yearns to contact her father when the crew lands on a planet laden with mystics, seers and also frauds.

programmes.t: Farscape: Farscape: S3 E3 - Self Inflicted Wounds, Part 1: Could'a, Would'a, Should'a
programmes.d: Moya approaches a wormhole, gets pulled in and fused to another ship.
The crew encounters a group of escaped Peacekeeper prisoners including a Nebari, a Scarran and a female Hynerian.

programmes.t: Farscape: Farscape: S3 E4 - Self Inflicted Wounds, Part 2: Wait For The Wheel
programmes.d: The crew works out a way of getting free from the other ship and out of the wormhole.
A dangerous situation forces the crew to make a tough decision.

programmes.t: Farscape: Farscape: S3 E5 - Different Destinations
programmes.d: Stark accidentally sends himself, Crichton, Aeryn. D'Argo and Jool are back in time where they alter the timeline.
Crichton, Aeryn and Crais are welcomed aboard Scorpius' carrier; Scorpius promises amnesty in exchange for wormhole technology; Scorpius threatens to destroy something close to Crichton's heart.

programmes.t: Farscape: Farscape: S3 E6 - Eat Me
programmes.d: In need of supplies, Crichton lands his transport pod on a dying leviathan which is full of hungry cannibals.
An unlikely source betrays the crew while trying to stop Scorpius' master plan.

programmes.t: Farscape: Farscape: S3 E7 - Thanks For Sharing
programmes.d: Moya rendezvous with Talyn who is seriously damaged. They hide in the atmosphere of a planet to prevent the Peacekeepers from finding them.
The crew must overcome a difficult challenge or face being torn apart; Crichton is haunted by visions of love and death.

programmes.t: Farscape: Farscape: S3 E8 - Green Eyed Monster
programmes.d: Talyn is swallowed by a boodong, leaving Stark and Rygel stranded in a transport pod.
Danish Crichton tries to survive aboard the Elack; a female alien and mercenaries are keen to harvest Elack's neural tissue.

programmes.t: Farscape: Farscape: S3 E9 - Losing Time
programmes.d: The crew of Moya starts blacking out and missing portions of time.
Crichton falls under the control of the mysterious and dangerous allure and control of Commandant Grayza.
Talyn lands on a planet covered mostly with vegetation that will help him to heal. Crichton, Aeryn and Crais leave the ship in search of Xhalax.
D'Argo and Sikozu develop a plan to run into the Peacekeepers' ship with Elack, but success requires Crichton getting closer to Grayza.

programmes.t: Farscape: Farscape: S2 E12 - Look At The Princess, Part 2: I Do, I Think
programmes.d: The Queen offers Crichton a choice; marry her daughter the crown princess, or she'll turn him over to Scorpius.
The crew faces a lava-filled cave and a mercenary squad after an emergency landing.

programmes.t: Farscape: Farscape: S2 E13 - Look At The Princess, Part 3: The Maltese Crichton
programmes.d: John Crichton faces eighty years as a statue. That is, until the Scarran Cargn decapitates the statue and drops the head into a vat of acid.
The crew reunites at Moya, where Crichton discovers that Aeryn is suffering from heatstroke and is being cared for by Scorpius, who is seeking asylum at Moya.

programmes.t: Farscape: Farscape: S2 E14 - Beware Of Dog
programmes.d: The crew bring aboard an alien tracker to remove some creatures that came aboard hidden in some cargo.
Crichton correctly predicts a wormhole's appearance near Moya, but simultaneously a giant space plant captures the Leviathan.

programmes.t: Farscape: Farscape: S2 E15 - Won't Get Fooled Again
programmes.d: Crichton has returned to Earth. Or has he always been on Earth all this time? People from his past and present appear.
Crichton and Chiana get stuck in a video game where they encounter strange and twisted versions of their friends.

programmes.t: Farscape: Farscape: S2 E16 - The Locket
programmes.d: A temporal distortion traps Aeryn and John on a planet's surface, where they live out the rest of their lives.
When a gang of bounty hunters overtakes Moya, Crichton must team with a dubious ally.

programmes.t: Farscape: Farscape: S2 E17 - The Ugly Truth
programmes.d: Crais and Talyn return. The crew are put on trial for an attack that Talyn made on an alien ship.
Chiana and Crichton are sucked into a game world ruled by a virtual stark; to escape, they must fight against friends and enemies in disguises.

programmes.t: Farscape: Farscape: S2 E18 - A Clockwork Nebari
programmes.d: A Nebari group comes aboard Moya and attempts to mind cleanse everyone using a drug. Pilot and Rygel are the only two who can resist the effects.
An alien doctor poisons the Moya's crew with deadly mollusks.
